subject.title: fix(feishu): disable ambient proxy inheritance for WebSocket by default

question: Should Feishu WebSocket egress switch from ambient-proxy-by-default to direct-by-default with `OPENCLAW_FEISHU_WS_USE_PROXY=1` opt-in, or should the current proxy default stay until broader Feishu proxy policy is settled?
rationale: The code change is small, but it changes upgrade behavior and an operator egress-control boundary for an inbound channel, which automation cannot safely decide from tests alone.

options.title: Finish Direct Default
options.body: Require docs, test cleanup, real transport proof, and a branch refresh, then merge direct-by-default if maintainers accept the proxy-boundary tradeoff.

options.title: Preserve Proxy Default
options.body: Keep ambient proxy inheritance as the upgrade default and pursue an explicit direct/bypass option instead.

options.title: Pause For Broader Policy
options.body: Hold or close this PR until the broader Feishu HTTP/WebSocket proxy policy work decides one channel-level contract.

recommendation.title: Finish Direct Default
recommendation.body: Require docs, test cleanup, real transport proof, and a branch refresh, then merge direct-by-default if maintainers accept the proxy-boundary tradeoff.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is tied to the shared ambient proxy helper and proxy/security boundary context most central to the decision.
